import re
src = open('scheduler.py').read()

old_refill_start = src.index("    def _refill(self, q):")
old_refill_end = src.index("    def _serve(self, q, pkt, evicted, i, old_t, log):")
new_refill = '''    def _refill(self, q):
        """Move the staging head into the PIFO and apply pushout.

        All ``min(refill_batch, population)`` transfers happen first; the
        resulting candidate set is then trimmed to the longest prefix whose
        bytes fit, evicting the suffix in descending (rank, ordinal) order.
        Returns the evicted identifiers in that order.
        """
        batch = self.refill_batch
        count = self.fcnt[q]
        if count < batch:
            batch = count
        ver = self.ver
        evicted = []
        if batch:
            fifo = self.fifo[q]
            head = self.fhead[q]
            pifo = self.pifo[q]
            bytes_used = self.pbytes[q]
            priors = self.priors.take
            moved = 0
            while moved < batch:
                pkt = fifo[head]
                head += 1
                if pkt is None:        # cancelled while staged
                    continue
                moved += 1
                self.fbytes[q] -= pkt.length
                self.fcnt[q] -= 1
                pifo = lean_insert(pifo, (pkt.rank, pkt.oid), pkt,
                                   priors(), ver)
                bytes_used += pkt.length
            self.fhead[q] = head
            self.pifo[q] = pifo
            self.pbytes[q] = bytes_used
        bytes_used = self.pbytes[q]
        cap = self.pifo_cap
        if bytes_used > cap:
            pifo = self.pifo[q]
            while bytes_used > cap:
                pifo, node = lean_extract_max(pifo, ver)
                over = node[1]
                bytes_used -= over.length
                self.live = fat_pop(self.live, (over.rank, over.oid),
                                    None, ver, 0)[0]
                evicted.append(over.pktid)
            self.pifo[q] = pifo
            self.pbytes[q] = bytes_used
        return evicted

'''
src = src[:old_refill_start] + new_refill + src[old_refill_end:]

old_serve = src[src.index("    def _serve(self, q, pkt, evicted, i, old_t, log):"):
                src.index("    # ------------------------------------------------------------- commands")]
new_serve = '''    def _finish_service(self, q, pkt, evicted, i, old_t, log):
        """Rank recalculation and lag accounting for a successful pop."""
        self.pbytes[q] -= pkt.length
        key = (pkt.rank, pkt.oid)
        self.policy.post_dequeue(pkt, pkt.rank)
        self.live, lag, rank_error = fat_pop(self.live, key, pkt.rank,
                                             self.ver, 0)
        log.append([i, 'dequeue', old_t, q, pkt.pktid, pkt.rank,
                    rank_error, lag, evicted])

'''
src = src[:src.index("    def _serve(self, q, pkt, evicted, i, old_t, log):")] + new_serve + \
      src[src.index("    # ------------------------------------------------------------- commands"):]

old_dq_start = src.index("    def cmd_dequeue(self, i, count, log):")
old_dq_end = src.index("    def cmd_sample(self, i, log):")
new_dq = '''    def cmd_dequeue(self, i, count, log):
        M = self.M
        for _ in range(count):
            old_t = self.t
            q = self.p
            nxt = q + 1
            self.p = 0 if nxt >= M else nxt
            self.t = old_t + 1
            if self.pifo[q] is not None:
                # The head is served and frees its bytes before a refill.
                self.pifo[q], node = lean_extract_min(self.pifo[q], self.ver)
                pkt = node[1]
                evicted = self._refill(q)
                self._finish_service(q, pkt, evicted, i, old_t, log)
            else:
                evicted = self._refill(q)
                root = self.pifo[q]
                if root is not None:
                    self.pifo[q], node = lean_extract_min(root, self.ver)
                    self._finish_service(q, node[1], evicted, i, old_t, log)
                else:
                    log.append([i, 'dequeue', old_t, q, None, None, 0, 0,
                                evicted])

'''
src = src[:old_dq_start] + new_dq + src[old_dq_end:]
open('scheduler.py','w').write(src)
print("patched")
